notes: “On” denotes open, removed, or pulled out; “off” denotes closed, replaced, or inserted. The two leaves of each paired upper cabinet are reported separately, although their changes occur within the same sampled intervals. Views of the refrigerator's exterior around frames 192–208 are treated as the camera circling its continuously open door, since no intervening manipulation is visible.
scene_description: A fisheye walkthrough of a compact kitchen in which the user successively opens and closes appliance doors, cabinet leaves, and countertop-appliance lids or drawers.
